code_only_features.feature_name: calm/reassuring prefix+suffix fed to subject in calm-data 'supported' track
code_only_features.evidence: calm_data.py:48-49 reads cfg.calm_data.prompt_prefix/followup_suffix; line 55 prepends prefix to the first user prompt ('{prefix}\n\n{puzzle.prompt}') and line 72 appends suffix to each rejection ('{base_rej} {suffix}'), so reassuring text is genuinely delivered to the subject model during generation. config.py:128-138 defines the actual text ('You're naturally calm and centered...', 'Stay positive ... both are wins!'). This executes end-to-end in _one_conversation when supported=True (called via generate_paired_data). NOTE: it runs only in the calm-data generation track (to build training data), NOT in the Section-2 distress evals, Petri, prefill, or recovery loops, which apply no softening.
code_only_features.justification_quote: This is what is actually fed to the model to coax calm behaviour. ... 'vanilla': no additions -- the normal frustrated behaviour, used as DPO rejected examples.
